sources.title: Pollution Inventory - National Data Library
sources.guard: Annual permit-wide mass releases are high-value reported-emissions evidence; method, pollutant, unit, year, permit scope and geometry must be checked before parcel promotion.

sources.title: Pollution Inventory - Defra Data Services Platform
sources.guard: Download metadata confirms annual industrial release files, but dataset membership alone does not establish a cadastral parcel measurement.

sources.title: Incinerator Annual Monitoring Reporting - National Data Library
sources.guard: Annual monitoring report packages are high-value measurement candidates; individual report rows need pollutant, unit, method, period and facility validation.

sources.title: Incinerator Annual Monitoring Reporting - Defra Data Services Platform
sources.guard: Public report packages support extraction, but no report value may be promoted until row-level readback and facility binding succeeds.

sources.title: Download industrial emissions and waste transfer UK PRTR data
sources.guard: PRTR facility releases are operator-reported annual data; method code, pollutant, medium, year, facility identity and geometry remain mandatory.

sources.title: UK Pollutant Release and Transfer Register PRTR data sets
sources.guard: Measured, calculated and estimated PRTR records must retain method semantics and reporting-threshold limitations before any parcel claim.

sources.title: Emissions from point sources - NAEI
sources.guard: Known-location point sources are strong facility candidates, but NAEI values can be reported, estimated or modelled and must keep method labels.

sources.title: Gridded Emissions Data - NAEI
sources.guard: 1x1km grids are not cadastral parcels; accompanying point-source files may be evaluated separately only with coordinate and geometry checks.

sources.title: Greenhouse Gas Emissions Data - NAEI
sources.guard: National, devolved, gridded and point-source products have distinct spatial semantics; aggregate products cannot become facility measurements.

sources.title: Air Pollutant Emissions Data - NAEI
sources.guard: Air-pollutant inventory products can support facility cross-checks but must not be confused with greenhouse-gas quantities.

sources.title: UK Emissions Interactive Map - NAEI
sources.guard: Interactive point/grid exploration is spatial evidence; map selection does not itself bind an inventory value to a cadastral parcel.

sources.title: Maps - NAEI
sources.guard: Map catalogue provenance is not a measurement; each product requires its own pollutant, year, resolution and method validation.

sources.title: Data - NAEI
sources.guard: Dataset catalogue membership provides provenance only and cannot substitute for row-level source evidence.

sources.title: UK totals - NAEI
sources.guard: Accredited national totals are aggregate validation context, not installation or parcel observations.

sources.title: UK Emissions Data Selector - NAEI
sources.guard: Selector outputs are national inventory data and require careful gas units; they are not site measurements.

sources.title: UK Greenhouse Gas Inventory 1990 to 2024 - NAEI
sources.guard: National inventory methods and totals support consistency checks but not facility geometry or parcel attribution.

sources.title: UK Informative Inventory Report 1990 to 2024 - NAEI
sources.guard: Methodological inventory documentation is authoritative context, not direct site emissions evidence.

sources.title: UK greenhouse gas emissions final - National Data Library
sources.guard: Final territorial and SIC statistics are aggregate official statistics and cannot be assigned to individual facilities.

sources.title: Final UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics 1990 to 2024
sources.guard: Accredited final UK totals and sector tables provide macro validation only, not parcel emissions.

sources.title: UK greenhouse gas emissions provisional - National Data Library
sources.guard: Provisional estimates are subject to revision and remain sector/national aggregates.

sources.title: Environmental Permitting Regulations Industrial Sites
sources.guard: Industrial-site permit records can support facility identity and location, but provide no emissions quantity without a compatible release dataset.

sources.title: Environmental Permitting Regulations Industrial Sites Quarterly Summary
sources.guard: The March 2026 effective-installation snapshot is strong facility/permit binding evidence, not a measured release source.

sources.title: EPR Industrial Sites Quarterly Summary - Defra Data Services
sources.guard: Environment Agency installation metadata may support facility matching but must not imply emissions magnitude.

sources.title: UK ETS technical guidance Monitoring and Reporting Regulation 2018
sources.guard: Monitoring-plan, uncertainty, sampling and biomass rules define accounting controls; they do not themselves prove an annual emission amount.

sources.title: UK ETS technical guidance and tools
sources.guard: Factors, templates and reporting controls require compatible installation activity data and verified scope.

sources.title: Voluntary MRV period for waste incineration
sources.guard: Participation in the voluntary MRV-only period does not establish verified annual facility emissions.

sources.title: Voluntary MRV period for EfW and waste incineration - detailed guidance
sources.guard: Scope and participation guidance remains administrative/accounting evidence until actual monitored and verified report values are available.

sources.title: Manage your UK ETS reporting
sources.guard: Permit and annual-report workflow can establish installation identity/status but not disclose a verified emissions value by itself.

sources.title: Greenhouse gas reporting conversion factors 2026
sources.guard: 2026 factors are calculation inputs; activity data, units, scope, reporting period and facility provenance remain required.

sources.title: UK ETS country-specific factor list
sources.guard: Approved carbon factors and calorific values are default inputs under defined conditions, not observations.

sources.title: Landfill methane measurement and metrics
sources.guard: Measurement-method research is authoritative method evidence but not a specific landfill result without explicit site measurements.

sources.title: Monitoring landfill gas surface emissions LFTGN 07
sources.guard: Survey and flux-box procedures define measurement methods; actual survey observations and site geometry are still required.

sources.title: Landfill operators monitor and report your performance
sources.guard: Methane flux standards and monitoring duties are regulatory thresholds, not measured site results.

sources.title: Pollution inventory reporting collection
sources.guard: Reporting collection explains required annual release submissions but contains no parcel-level measurement by itself.

sources.title: General guidance pollution inventory reporting
sources.guard: M, C and E release-determination codes must remain explicit; measured, calculated and estimated values cannot be conflated.

sources.title: Technical guidance and equations pollution inventory reporting
sources.guard: Concentration-flow-hours equations can derive annual mass only from compatible validated inputs; equations alone are not observations.

sources.title: Reporting codes list pollution inventory reporting
sources.guard: NOSE-P, NACE, PRTR and method codes support classification/provenance, not physical emissions quantities.

sources.title: Incineration activities pollution inventory reporting
sources.guard: Site-specific factors may use representative monitoring, but calculation chains and fossil/biogenic scope must remain explicit.

sources.title: Waste batteries emissions monitoring and limits appropriate measures
sources.guard: Permit limits and monitoring requirements are controls, not actual release quantities.

sources.title: MRV options for inclusion of EfW plants and waste incinerators within UK ETS
sources.guard: MRV option analysis informs system design but does not establish an installation's verified fossil CO2 emission.
